title: Make pause and clear non-destructive; hide cleared goals
description: User lifecycle commands must not cancel running turns, and cleared goals must disappear from status, tools, and widget. Keep replacement aborts.

logs.msg: Verified in Pi 0.84.4 host code: extension commands run immediately mid-stream (source of the destructive abort), abort() does not clear message queues, continuations dequeue before provider requests. Implemented releaseRuntime (lease+dispatch release, no abort), stale-continuation abort at message_start, cleared hidden from /goal status, get_goal, and widget, replacement rebinding with fresh lease, supervisor-blocked releases lease and terminates cleanly. 46 tests/tsc/diff-check pass.
